name: vwap_slope_momentum_v1
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: When NIFTY's session VWAP sustains an elevated linear-regression slope (z-score > 1.5 persisting 25+ seconds), it reflects active institutional TWAP execution — large buy-side desks slicing directional orders into the NIFTY futures book, weighted by volume. NIFTY futures market makers continuously quote against VWAP benchmarks, so a persistently steep VWAP slope forces their delta-hedging in the same direction, amplifying the initial institutional push and creating short-term price momentum at the index level. The 5-bar persistence requirement (25 seconds at 5s bars) filters NIFTY's inherent single-candle noise and confirms the slope is institutionally sustained — we enter as that flow continues and ride the 30-90 second continuation.

indicators.name: vwap
indicators.purpose: Cumulative — no scaling. VWAP resets at 09:15 each session. The slope of this cumulative average captures the direction and intensity of institutional volume-weighted demand.

indicators.name: vwap_slope_bps
indicators.purpose: 24 bars = 2 minutes. Original was 20 bars on 1-min = 20 minutes. Compressed to 2 min because at 5s we hold 30-90s; a 2-min regression captures enough curvature to detect directional acceleration without lagging more than 30s. Longer would defeat the 25s persistence filter.

indicators.name: vwap_slope_zscore
indicators.purpose: 240 bars = 20 minutes. Original normalized over 120 min. 20 min is sufficient to capture current-session volatility regime — VWAP slope naturally flattens intraday, so the z-score corrects for that drift. Shorter than original because 5s resolution produces more data points and 20 min is already 240 observations.

indicators.name: price_above_vwap
indicators.purpose: Confirms price is on the correct side of VWAP — required for long entries (CE) or short entries (PE). Identical to original.

conditions: vwap_slope_zscore > 1.5 for 5 consecutive bars (25 seconds of persistence)
buy_ce.confirmation: All 5 bars must satisfy z-score threshold — no single-bar lookahead

conditions: vwap_slope_zscore < -1.5 for 5 consecutive bars (25 seconds of persistence)
buy_pe.confirmation: All 5 bars must satisfy negative z-score threshold

exit.stop_rationale: 4 option pts = ~8 NIFTY spot points. If NIFTY reverses 8 pts while VWAP slope was supposedly steepening, the institutional flow thesis is invalidated. NIFTY 30s moves average 2-5 option pts; 4 pts stop gives one full typical-move of room without exposing to large drawdowns.
exit.target_rationale: 6 option pts = ~12 NIFTY spot points. Sustained VWAP slope momentum at z-score > 1.5 drives 10-18 spot pts in 30-60s; 6 captures the lower end of this range at delta ~0.5. Gives 1:1.5 R:R with high-conviction directional signal.

filters.vix_filter: vix < 24 — above 24 NIFTY is volatile enough that VWAP slope signals become whippy and institutional TWAP execution is less predictable
filters.time_filter: no entry before 09:30 — VWAP is cumulative and needs 15 min of volume to produce a stable slope; first 15 min slope is dominated by opening auction artifacts
filters.trend_filter: price_above_vwap for long, price_below_vwap for short — trades only in the direction the market is currently positioned vs. its own average
filters.spread_filter: limit orders at candle close — no spread filter needed

edge.edge_decay_risk: medium — VWAP slope is not widely used at 5s intraday but as index-algo penetration grows, this edge may compress over 12-24 months

adaptation_notes: Original: equity FnO stocks, 1-min bars, 20-min slope, 120-min z-score, 5-bar (5-min) confirmation, hold 30-120 min. Converted: (1) VWAP is cumulative — no scaling needed, just fewer bars needed for stable estimate; (2) slope window compressed from 20 min to 2 min because we hold 30-90s, not 30-120 min; we're catching the early burst, not the full trend; (3) z-score window compressed from 120 min to 20 min — enough observations (240) to normalize slope while remaining responsive to current-session volatility regime; (4) 5-bar persistence translates directly: 5 bars × 5s = 25 seconds of sustained VWAP slope confirms institutional flow, not a noise spike; (5) ATR stop replaced with fixed option premium points calibrated to typical NIFTY 30-90s move sizes; (6) volume filter removed — VWAP is volume-weighted by construction, making a separate volume > SMA filter redundant.
weaknesses: VWAP slope flattens mechanically as session progresses (more volume dilutes new trades into cumulative average), reducing signal quality post-13:00
5-bar persistence requirement creates 25-second entry lag — enter after 25 seconds of confirming z-score, which means a portion of the initial move is missed on fast NIFTY momentum bursts
During high-volatility regimes (VIX > 24), the VIX filter sits out — but precisely when VWAP slope gives the cleanest signals on large institutional flows, we may be excluded

_source.original_stop: vwap level at entry (dynamic, ~1 ATR below)
